sources.entry: faster-whisper - A Whisper reimplementation on CTranslate2, up to 4 times faster than openai-whisper with less memory.

summary.one_liner: faster-whisper is a reimplementation of OpenAI's Whisper speech-recognition model on the CTranslate2 inference engine, claimed to be up to 4x faster with less memory.
summary.what_it_does: The library loads Whisper-family speech recognition models (by size name such as large-v3 or turbo, or from a local or Hub-hosted CTranslate2 conversion) and transcribes audio files. It exposes a WhisperModel class whose transcribe method returns a generator of segments with start and end times, plus language detection info. A BatchedInferencePipeline offers a drop-in batched variant for higher throughput on GPU. Options include word-level timestamps, Silero VAD filtering to drop non-speech audio, and int8/float16 compute types for CPU and GPU. The README also documents a ct2-transformers-converter script for converting Transformers-format Whisper models, and benchmark tables comparing speed and memory against openai/whisper, whisper.cpp and transformers.
use_cases: transcribe audio or video recordings to text
run Whisper on a GPU with lower VRAM
run speech-to-text on a CPU with int8 quantization
build a transcription server or real-time pipeline
how_to_run: from faster_whisper import WhisperModel; model = WhisperModel("large-v3", device="cuda", compute_type="float16")
for segment in segments: print(segment.start, segment.end, segment.text)
notable: Up to 4x faster than openai/whisper for the same accuracy, with lower memory use, per the README benchmarks
Does not require FFmpeg to be installed system-wide, since audio decoding uses PyAV
BatchedInferencePipeline is a drop-in replacement for transcribe that trades VRAM for speed
Supports 8-bit quantization on both CPU and GPU
Distil-Whisper checkpoints are compatible, including distil-large-v3
caveats: GPU use requires separately installed NVIDIA cuBLAS and cuDNN 9 for CUDA 12; CUDA 11 or cuDNN 8 need pinned older ctranslate2 versions
Transcription is lazy: the segments generator only runs when iterated
Benchmark numbers are the project's own and depend on hardware and settings
